asking_supply.text: What's a detail about that stretch of river you haven't told me yet?
Who else has stayed there with you since?

turns.text: Good, actually — we finally got the roof trusses up last weekend. My brother drove up from Tulsa to help, and we got the whole frame closed in before it rained Sunday night.
The roof trusses up, and your brother who drove up from Tulsa helping close in the whole frame before Sunday's rain — that's real progress.
Yeah, and we're hoping to get the windows in before the first frost.
Windows in before the first frost — that's a good next target with the frame already closed in.
